# Build an AI-Powered Document Analysis & Q&A Platform (Python, LLM, RAG)

**Project Type:** Fixed Price 
**Budget:** $1,500 USD 
**Timeline:** 3 Weeks 
**Experience Level:** Expert

### Project Description

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML developer to build a web-based intelligent document analysis platform using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

The application should allow users to upload PDF documents, ask questions in natural language, and receive accurate, context-aware answers based on the uploaded content.

We want a functional MVP with clean, maintainable code and a user-friendly interface.

### Core Requirements

**1. Document Processing**
- Upload and process text-based PDF documents.
- Support up to 30 documents per workspace, with a maximum of 10 MB per document.
- Extract, clean, and split document text into meaningful chunks.
- Generate and store embeddings for semantic retrieval.

**2. AI/ML Integration**
- Integrate an LLM API such as OpenAI.
- Implement a RAG pipeline using LangChain or LlamaIndex.
- Use a vector database such as ChromaDB or FAISS.
- Support semantic search and context-based question answering.
- Display source references with document names and page numbers.
- Clearly indicate when the documents do not contain enough information to answer a question.

**3. Backend Development**
- Python with FastAPI.
- REST APIs for document uploading, management, and querying.
- Basic error handling, logging, and secure API key management.

**4. Frontend Development**
- React.js with a clean, responsive UI.
- Document upload and management interface.
- Chat interface for asking questions.
- Answer display with source citations.

### Expected Deliverables

1. Fully functional web application with frontend and backend.
2. Working document processing and RAG pipeline.
3. Source code delivered through a Git repository.
4. Docker-based local setup instructions.
5. README with installation and configuration instructions.
6. Demonstration using sample documents and at least 10 agreed test questions.
7. Bug fixes for issues identified during final acceptance testing.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Users can upload, view, and delete supported PDF documents.
- Uploaded documents can be searched through natural-language questions.
- Responses include verifiable references to relevant documents and pages.
- The system handles unsupported files and API errors gracefully.
- The full application can be started following the supplied setup documentation.
- All agreed demonstration test cases are completed successfully.

### Preferred Technical Skills

Python, FastAPI, React.js, LLMs, OpenAI API, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, Docker, and REST APIs.

### Payment Milestones

- **Milestone 1 — $300:** Architecture, environment setup, PDF extraction, and chunking.
- **Milestone 2 — $700:** Working embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG pipeline, and backend APIs.
- **Milestone 3 — $500:** Completed frontend, testing, documentation, and final delivery.

### Additional Information

The fixed budget covers development and delivery of the defined MVP. Third-party API usage and production hosting costs are excluded.

Only text-based PDFs are required. OCR, authentication, payment integration, custom model training, and production-scale infrastructure are outside the initial scope.

Please include relevant AI/ML project examples, your proposed technical approach, and confirmation that you can deliver within the timeline.

We are interested in working with developers who write clean code, communicate clearly, and have practical experience building AI-powered applications.

We currently use Zoho CRM, Zoho Books and Zoho Inventory to manage sales, purchasing, inventory, invoicing and stock movements.

We require a freelancer who can identify the underlying causes of these problems, implement appropriate corrections and establish reliable processes that prevent the issues from recurring.

**This is not a new Zoho implementation. It is an audit, corrective action and optimisation project within an existing operational Zoho environment.**

Our objective is to achieve a reliable, accurate and manageable system that our team can confidently use without ongoing intervention from external consultants.

## Scope of Works

### Phase 1 – System Audit and Root-Cause Analysis

Conduct a detailed review of our existing Zoho environment, including:

- Zoho Inventory settings, configurations and transaction history.
- Integration and data synchronisation between Zoho CRM, Books and Inventory.
- Existing inventory item classifications and master records.
- Current physical stock quantities versus recorded stock balances.
- Negative inventory quantities and historical discrepancies.
- Outstanding, incomplete or incorrectly processed purchase orders.
- Purchasing, receiving, sales order and dispatch workflows.
- Assembly and composite product configurations.
- Existing stock transfers and warehouse processes.
- Freight, landed-cost and inventory valuation workflows.

**Required deliverable:**

A written audit report identifying the root causes of the discrepancies, configuration problems, recommended corrective actions and any relevant Zoho limitations.

The report should include a prioritised action plan before implementation begins.

### Phase 2 – Inventory Reconciliation and Corrections

Review and correct agreed inventory discrepancies to establish an accurate starting position.

Tasks include:

- Reconcile agreed inventory items against verified physical stock records.
- Investigate and correct negative stock balances.
- Review and resolve outstanding or incorrectly processed purchase orders.
- Identify and correct duplicate, obsolete or incorrectly configured inventory items.
- Correct relevant inventory transactions where appropriate.
- Ensure stock adjustments are accurately documented.
- Verify resulting stock quantities against agreed physical inventory records.

**Required deliverable:**

An updated Zoho Inventory environment with agreed corrections completed, verified stock balances and a documented list of any outstanding exceptions.

### Phase 3 – Purchasing, Assembly and Inventory Process Optimisation

We operate with a mixture of imported finished goods, locally manufactured products, imported components and products assembled locally.

We require Zoho to manage these different product categories accurately.

Review and optimise the following:

**Purchasing and goods receipting**
- Purchase order creation and management.
- Supplier invoice and goods receipt processes.
- Partial receipts and outstanding orders.
- Imported products and changing supplier purchase prices.

**Product assembly**
- Composite and assembled item configurations.
- Component inventory deductions.
- Finished product stock movements.
- Purchasing and assembly workflows.

**Freight and landed costs**
- Allocation and recording of freight and associated import costs.
- Foreign currency purchasing considerations.
- Inventory cost and valuation accuracy.

**Warehouse and stock management**
- Stock transfers and adjustments.
- Sales order allocation and dispatch processes.
- Appropriate transaction completion procedures.
- Prevention of recurring inventory discrepancies.

**Required deliverable:**

Correctly configured and tested workflows that accurately reflect our operational processes and inventory movements.

### Phase 4 – Zoho Integration Review

Review the integration between:

- Zoho CRM
- Zoho Books
- Zoho Inventory

Identify and resolve agreed integration or configuration issues affecting purchasing, stock records, sales orders, invoicing and inventory transactions.

The objective is to ensure that relevant data is accurately transferred and maintained across the applications.

This is not intended to be a complete CRM redesign or a new system implementation.

**Required deliverable:**

Successful testing of representative end-to-end business transactions, with any remaining integration limitations documented.

### Phase 5 – Testing, Documentation and Training

Once corrections and configurations have been completed, conduct practical testing using real business scenarios.

Testing should include:

- Creating purchase orders and receiving stock.
- Recording supplier invoices and relevant costs.
- Completing product assembly transactions.
- Confirming component deductions and finished product quantities.
- Creating and processing sales orders.
- Completing inventory dispatch and stock movements.
- Verifying inventory quantities and relevant financial records.

We also require written standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the relevant workflows.

Provide remote training for our management team to ensure we understand how to operate and maintain the corrected system.

**Required deliverables:**

- Completed functional testing.
- Written operating procedures.
- Remote staff training session.
- Final project completion report.
- Documented unresolved issues and recommendations.

## Project Milestones

We propose the following milestones, with payment released following satisfactory completion of each stage.

**Milestone 1 – System Audit and Findings (20%)**

Complete system review and provide a written root-cause analysis with a recommended correction plan.

**Milestone 2 – Inventory Reconciliation (30%)**

Complete agreed stock corrections, purchasing transaction resolutions and inventory master-data improvements.

**Milestone 3 – Process and Integration Optimisation (30%)**

Implement and test agreed purchasing, assembly, freight, warehouse and integration improvements.

**Milestone 4 – Verification, Documentation and Handover (20%)**

Complete testing, written SOPs, training and final project handover.

## Project Completion Expectations

This is a deliverables-based project.

We are specifically looking for a freelancer who is willing to take responsibility for satisfactorily completing an agreed scope of work rather than simply billing for time spent investigating issues.

We recognise that some historical discrepancies may be unresolvable due to missing records or software limitations. These should be identified and documented during the project.

However, all agreed and technically achievable corrective actions must be completed and tested before final project sign-off.

Any additional work outside the agreed scope must be discussed and approved before commencement.

## Required Freelancer Experience

Applicants should demonstrate:

- Extensive experience with Zoho Inventory, Books and CRM.
- Proven experience troubleshooting existing Zoho implementations.
- Strong knowledge of inventory reconciliation and stock management.
- Experience with composite items, product assemblies and component inventory.
- Familiarity with importing, wholesale distribution and landed-cost processes.
- Knowledge of Zoho integrations, workflows and automation.
- Ability to produce practical written documentation.
- Strong English communication skills.
- Previous experience working with Australian businesses is preferred but not essential.

We are looking for a hands-on technical specialist who can personally investigate and resolve problems rather than a project manager coordinating a large consulting team.

## How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Your experience with Zoho Inventory, Books and CRM.
2. Examples of similar inventory reconciliation or system correction projects you have completed.
3. Your experience with composite items, imported products and stock valuation.
4. Your proposed approach to identifying the root causes of our issues.
5. Your estimated fixed project price in Australian dollars.
6. Your expected project completion timeframe.
7. Confirmation that you are comfortable working to agreed milestones and measurable deliverables.
8. Details of any post-implementation support you provide.

Please begin your proposal with the words "Zoho Inventory Specialist" so we know you have read the requirements.

We are looking to engage the right person promptly and would welcome proposals from experienced independent specialists who can deliver practical results at a competitive price.

full_description:
Shopify Product Data Cleanup + Multi-Store Copy (Master Store ~3,200 Products)

Project Overview
We need a complete product data cleanup on our master Australian Shopify store (approximately 3,200 products), followed by controlled copying of the cleaned data to three other stores.

This is a data-quality and content job. Theme work, Google Ads, and Merchant Centre setup are out of scope.

Part 1 – Full Cleanup on Master Store Only
The master store currently has significant data quality issues that must be fixed before any copying occurs:
• Majority of products have only 1 image
• Product Type field is almost completely empty
• Large number of missing SKUs
• Many thin or incomplete descriptions
• Missing or incomplete barcodes/GTINs
• Tags are generic and need improvement
• SEO and AEO content needs strengthening

Required work on the master store:
• Add real product images: minimum 2 images per product, ideally 3–5 where available (main pack shot + additional angles, usage, ingredients, etc.).
• Images should ideally be on a white background to match the style of our other stores.
• Only real manufacturer or high-quality product images. Never use fake or AI-generated images.
• Fill Product Type on every product using clear, consistent values.
• Improve and expand tags.
• Complete missing SKUs using a consistent structure.
• Add real barcodes/GTINs wherever possible.
• Enrich thin descriptions (especially those under 300 characters) with useful content (what it is, key benefits, how to use, etc.).
• General SEO/AEO improvements to product data.

Image sourcing
You are expected to proactively source additional real manufacturer or high-quality product images. We will provide competitor website references to assist, but we will not spoon-feed every image. A proactive approach is required.

Barcodes
We will supply the barcodes we already have (covering a large portion of the catalogue). Approximately 30% will still be missing. If you have tools or reliable methods to research the remaining barcodes, please include this capability in your proposal. Never invent barcodes.

Brand Priority
We have approximately 100 brands. A clear priority order list will be provided. Work must follow the priority sequence we give you.

Part 2 – Copy Clean Data to 3 Other Stores
Only after the master store is fully cleaned and quality-checked:
• 2 stores receive the full cleaned catalogue
• 1 store receives the Korean beauty products (copied across to the relevant Korean-focused store)

New Zealand catalogue note
One of the stores has a New Zealand sales channel that automatically pulls from the main listing and excludes restricted products (e.g. electrical, aerosol). There is no separate full catalogue rebuild required. You simply need to ensure that during the upload/mapping process the existing sales channel settings remain correct and are cross-checked against the current configuration.

What Your Proposal Must Include
Bids that do not clearly cover the points below will not be considered:
1. Relevant experience with large Shopify product data cleanups and multi-store catalogue work.
2. Your proposed approach and process (step-by-step).
3. Exactly what you need from us to start and complete the job.
4. Realistic timeline with clear milestones (e.g. priority brands → rest of catalogue → copy stage).
5. Fixed price for the full scope (master cleanup + copy to the 3 stores).
6. Any assumptions or limitations (especially around image sourcing and barcode research).

Goal
Produce one clean, high-quality master catalogue and then accurately distribute it to the three target stores so we stop carrying data problems across multiple sites.

I am looking for an experienced freelance developer or small development team to design and develop a professional web-based **enterprise management system** covering learning, training, nonconformance management, continuous improvement and change management.

The modules should work together through common user accounts, permissions, approval workflows, document storage and reporting. The platform must support multiple organizations with separate data and work smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile browsers.

The scope includes:

- Learning and training management:** Course administration, registration, scheduling, attendance, assessments, certificates, training records, expiry reminders and competency tracking.
- Nonconformance report (NCR) management:** Create and categorize NCRs, assign responsible persons, record investigations and root causes, track corrective actions and deadlines, attach evidence, verify effectiveness and approve closure.
- Continuous improvement:** Capture improvement opportunities and suggestions, evaluate and prioritize proposals, assign actions, track implementation and record outcomes.
- Change management tracker:** Register proposed changes, document reasons, assess impacts and risks, obtain approvals, assign implementation actions and track completion and review.
- Administration and reporting:** Organization and user management, configurable forms and workflows, dashboards, notifications, document storage, audit trails and report exports.

The following expectations are essential:

- Complete development: Handle requirements clarification, UI/UX design, frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment. Deliver a fully functioning application ready for operational use.
- Agreed scope and milestones: Confirm requirements, dependencies, deliverables, timelines and acceptance criteria before development. Propose a practical phased delivery plan.
- Design approval: Provide wireframes or a clickable prototype for approval before full development.
- Integrated, maintainable architecture: Use consistent navigation and shared records across modules, with clear links between related NCRs, improvement actions and changes. The system must support future expansion.
- Security and traceability: Implement secure authentication, role-based permissions, separation of organizational data, protected documents, audit history and backup/recovery arrangements.
